## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Public package tests pass.
- [ ] Existing tracker and pipeline tests pass when affected.
- [ ] Tests use saved or synthetic provider responses.
- [ ] Direct application URLs and provider errors remain visible.
- [ ] Documentation and examples are updated.
- [ ] No credentials or personal applicant data are included.

## Provider evidence

For provider changes, identify the official endpoint and describe pagination, identity, dates, and failure behavior.
